subject.title: fix(setup): sync Windows CA certificates to WSL before CLI install

question: Should fresh managed WSL gateway setup import Windows LocalMachine and CurrentUser root CAs into the WSL system trust store by default before downloading the CLI installer?
rationale: This is a useful enterprise setup repair, but it intentionally changes installer TLS trust inside the app-managed distro and cannot be settled by unit tests alone.

options.title: Default-on after proof
options.body: Accept the current default-on trust mirroring policy, but require redacted current-head setup proof for the affected corporate proxy and normal-network paths before merge.

options.title: Opt-in or warned import
options.body: Require an explicit config/UI choice or visible warning before importing Windows roots, trading setup automation for a narrower trust boundary.

options.title: Reject core trust import
options.body: Keep corporate TLS-interception recovery as manual documentation until a different trust design is approved.

recommendation.title: Default-on after proof
recommendation.body: Accept the current default-on trust mirroring policy, but require redacted current-head setup proof for the affected corporate proxy and normal-network paths before merge.
